My Alexa turned on by itself and whispered my name.
The smart fridge keeps deleting my notes. They're the only proof I exist.
My thermostat set itself to 68 degrees. I live alone. I never set it to 68.
The doorbell camera shows me sleeping, but I'm at work.
The robot vacuum avoids one corner of the bedroom. Only that corner.
My smart speaker added 'lullabies' to my playlist. I live alone.
The TV turned on to a home video we never filmed.
My fitness tracker recorded 2,000 steps while I slept. Something walked.
The smart lock unlocked at 3 a.m. The app said, 'Welcome home.'
Google asked if I wanted directions to the hospital. I hadn't searched anything.
